native_mechanisms: Nightingales sent down every road from a place sing one note per stride and die at the first board, carving that board's fixed lattice slot with their dying note (out-edge scan writing a tentative distance per neighbour, keeping the fainter of colliding notes and never re-flying a spent road).

At each board a cow's-head woman milks a smaller cow to re-measure the note as it would arrive via the last settled board plus the connecting stretch, recutting the slot only when that milk is thinner (relaxation/improvement test against the stored value).

The quietest unsettled note in the lattice is always chosen next to settle, settled slots never revisited, until no note remains and unreached places stand blank as the desert (minimum-key extraction over the unsettled frontier, termination with INFINITY for unreachable).
core_technique: Dijkstra's algorithm with no priority queue: linear (AVX2/OpenMP-vectorised) min-scan over a compacted swap-removed frontier array of tentative distances, plus CSR out-edge relaxation and a settled-node bitmask.
